rule_summary.output_requirement: Every Phase2 packet must include space_reference_delta before being called space-referenced.
rule_summary.primary_refs: Use current user original + immediate predecessor PASS/HOLD report + latest next-work card + one domain/pressure artifact if it changes judgment.
reject_ref_when: reference increases operator load without changing decision
reference is authority/current-position/registry unless explicitly approved for read-only orientation
rule_summary.secondary_refs: Use older/broader space artifacts only when current refs conflict, are insufficient, or trigger architecture/layer ambiguity.
